subject: fix: stale-delta honesty, index-root guard, fail-closed verify; route-discipline steering (v0.40.0)
body:
Fixes from the 2026-08-09 cross-repo audit:

- prism_read: symbol SHAs are computed from the delivered file's bytes at
  each span, never the index's RawText — a stale index can no longer mask
  a fresh edit behind a [prism:cached] pointer.
- prism_index: foreign dirs are rejected like every other tool (the engine
  previously walked the other tree while pruning this root's database).
- prism_verify: failed index refresh, unparsable base version, or failed
  contract diff degrade the verdict to review instead of noting-and-passing.
- Freshness: refreshIndexBestEffort failures surface as staleWarning on
  graph-tool results; prism_arch_check refreshes before validating;
  AutoIndexIfEmpty fails loudly when Status errors.
- Removed the dead "tests" edge kind from every advertised surface.
- Native text-search fallback rejects symlinks resolving outside the root.
- Steering rewritten for route discipline: one call per need, small
  results for exploratory work, prism_index only on failure (indexing is
  now automatic on every whole-repo graph op).
- deps: grove v0.28.1 -> v0.29.0 (error propagation — breaking),
  astkit v0.4.22 -> v0.4.23.

Engine invariants harness: all corpora at/ab
